lines.text: In 1814, Humphry Davy toured Europe with his assistant, Michael Faraday.
lines.say: In eighteen fourteen, Humphry Davy toured Europe with his assistant, Michael Faraday.

lines.text: In Florence, Davy tried the Grand Duke's great burning lens on diamonds.
Florence scholars had seen diamonds vanish in its focus long before.
Davy sealed diamond fragments in a glass globe filled with oxygen.
Moved out of the focus, one kept burning with a scarlet light.
It burned for over four minutes, and Faraday called it beautiful.
The only product was carbon dioxide, so a diamond is pure carbon.
The lens is now kept in the Museo Galileo in Florence.
Florence chemists re-ran the experiment on November 14, 2025.
lines.say: Florence chemists re-ran the experiment on November fourteenth, twenty twenty five.
